citeAs: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan (2022). Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering. 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022).
creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
description: A large-scale multimodal multiple choice question dataset consisting of 21,208 science questions with diverse topics, annotated with corresponding lectures and explanations.
name: ScienceQA
publisher: University of California, Los Angeles; Arizona State University; Allen Institute for AI
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts using a data exploration tool.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Data was extracted using heuristic rules. Invalid questions were manually removed, answer options were shuffled, and semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions. Incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts.
rai:dataBiases: The authors state they have not found any improper content, such as pornographic information, racial remarks, or harmful social bias.
rai:dataCollection: Questions were downloaded from open resources managed by IXL Learning, and individual components were extracted based on heuristic rules.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Original science problems from K-12 education curricula on the IXL Learning platform.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Answer options of each question were shuffled to ensure the choices do not follow any specific pattern.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Extracted individual components based on heuristic rules, manually removed invalid questions (e.g., one choice, faulty data, duplicated), and used semi-automated scripts to reformat lectures and solutions.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Any antisocial data points will be removed from the dataset based on feedback.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is beneficial to follow-up research and real-world applications, contributing to the development of K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems.
rai:dataUseCases: Diagnosing the multimodal understanding and multi-hop reasoning abilities of AI systems, and developing K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat the lectures and solutions.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset does not contain any user usage data or personally sensitive information such as gender and race.

null_reasons.rai:annotationsPerItem: Not applicable; dataset was extracted from existing sources rather than independently annotated per item.
null_reasons.rai:annotatorDemographics: Not applicable; dataset was extracted via scripts and heuristic rules, with expert revision.
null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: No specific annotation platform is mentioned for dataset creation (only a custom data exploration tool).
null_reasons.rai:dataLimitations: No specific limitations of the dataset itself are discussed, only limitations of the models evaluated on it.
